o.text: Borrowed from Arabic لَائِحَة (lāʔiḥa). A semantic development into project sense is unclear.
From ad (“name”) + -la (“with; -y”, contraction of ilə). See also ad-san (“fame”).

From Proto-Common Turkic *yï̄d. Compare Turkmen ys, Uyghur ھىد (hid), Uzbek is (“smell, odor”), Kyrgyz жыт (jıt), Southern Altai јыт (ǰït, “smell”), Kazakh иіс (iyis), Tatar ис (is, “smell”), Bashkir еҫ (yiś, “smell”), etc.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish یك (yig), from Proto-Turkic *iyik. Cognate with Chuvash йӗке (jĕk̬e), etc.
From Persian همرای (ham-rây). By surface analysis, həm- (“same”) + rəy (“opinion, view”).
